643-6991-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-6991-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

661-1486-4231-4875--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Conspiracy, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Sculpting Steel. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Conspiracy, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

813-1922-2320.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn or an opponent's upkeep.
Lands you control tap for enough to cast Reset and Blur.
813-1922-2320.description:
Activate all your lands by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast your two spells.
Cast Reset by paying its mana cost, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages and drawing a card, and putting Blur into your graveyard as it resolves.
Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Blur to your hand.
Repeat.

1849-3755-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-3504.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-3504.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Mercurial Pretender each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-3504.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1580-3220-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4350-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Butcher Ghoul enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
4350-5256-6972.notes: If Butcher Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

575-2511-4294-7115.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}
When Etali enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Yedora triggers, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Holding priority, activate Etali by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, exiling cards from the top of each library until each player has exiled a nonland card, and causing you to cast any number of those cards without paying its mana cost.
For each card cast, Toph's second ability triggers once.
Resolve the first Toph trigger, earthbending Etali.
Resolve any remaining triggers, earthbending any other lands you desire. If you do not want to earthbend other lands, target Etali with all remaining triggers.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Toph and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, choosing not to return Etali.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 11.

252-1477-1575-5776.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

2173-5073-5220-7286.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4311-4668-5078.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
4311-4668-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

985-3713-4474-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-969-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

5670-6705-6719.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
5670-6705-6719.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

147-6797-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2018-6797-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have flying.
2018-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have flying.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with a flying counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.

2464-5051-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2464-5051-5078-6650.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-5051-5078-6650.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

643-4508-5880-6705.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Frog creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

856-2279-4659-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2972-5456-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Treasures.
2972-5456-6441.description:
Activate Magda by sacrificing three Treasures, creating two 4/4 Scorpion Dragon creature tokens with flying and haste.
When the Scorpion Dragons enter the battlefield, Ganax triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Repeat.

222-527-4885-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-4885-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1479-3257-5361.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
Kodama of the East Tree, Auton Soldier, and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
Auton Soldier and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Auton Soldier token's trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

56-2511-5695.notablePrerequisites: Infested Thrinax entered the battlefield this turn
56-2511-5695.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
Repeat from step 3.

628-2034-5405.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Soulstinger.
When Soulstinger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Soulstinger enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1381-4050-4190-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hateful Eidolon, adding {B}.
When Hateful Eidolon dies, Mortuary and Ashiok's Reaper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Hateful Eidolon on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Ashiok's Render trigger, causing you to draw Hateful Eidolon from your library.
Cast Hateful Eidolon by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1335-2034-2445.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2034-2445.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

147-3551-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures that can attack this turn.
147-3551-4499.description:
Declare at least four creatures you control as attackers.
Holding priority, cast Dragonrage by paying {2}{R}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Dragonrage.
Resolve the copy of Dragonrage, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

929-1636-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Sinstriker's Will attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
There is an attacking or blocking creature on the battlefield.
929-1636-3590.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Sinstriker's Will ability by tapping it, targeting any attacking or blocking creature.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

608-1209-1636-3141-5168.notablePrerequisites:
Jace's Archivist and Bloom Tender do not have summoning sickness.
A player has at least one card in their hand.
608-1209-1636-3141-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {U}{R}{G}.
Activate Jace's Archivist by paying {U} and tapping it, causing each player to discard their hand and draw cards equal to the greatest number of cards discarded by a single player this way.
Xyris triggers once for each card your opponent draw, and Kozilek triggers if it was discarded.
Resolve the first Xyris trigger, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
The Snake enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {U}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining Xyris trigger.
Resolve the Kozilek trigger from step 3, if applicable, causing you to shuffle your graveyard into your library.
Repeat from step 2.
